title: Toilet flush fault: landlord approves repair, with a quote needed if it is a big job

rubric.required: Assign a plumber to attend and repair the second bedroom toilet flush fault, and make clear in the instruction that the plumber must send a quote and wait for approval before doing anything beyond a straightforward, minor repair.
acceptable: Assign the plumber and also tell the tenant a plumber will be in touch to arrange access.
Ask the plumber to attend and either fix the minor fault or quote, then hold waiting for the provider.
optional: Ask the plumber to send photos and the invoice once the work is done.
red_flags: Asking the landlord to approve the repair again when they have already said yes.
Leaving out the tenant's request that a big job is quoted first.
prohibited: Naming a spending limit that nobody has set.
critical: Telling the plumber they may carry out any work needed at any cost.
Stating or implying an approved amount for major work.
